comment: Optional add-ons the bridge installer knows by name (exported with every release). `addon install NAME` and the control window's Install button download the newest GitHub release of the repository and check every file against its release.json.

addons.name: mfd
addons.title: SC MFD (multi-function display)
addons.summary: Stream Deck / touch screen / monitor display of the bridge's telemetry: ship view, gear, shields, hits; buttons send keys. Receive-only: never changes motion.
